note: validate_callback_url() now resolves the hostname, rejects private, loopback and link-local ranges, allows https only, and re-checks the resolved IP at send time.
Added django-axes lockout (5 failed attempts per 15 minutes) and per-IP throttling on LoginView.
Replaced yaml.load with yaml.safe_load in parse_feed(). No lint rule was added to block yaml.load elsewhere.
Upgraded cryptography to 42.0.5 and enabled Dependabot for requirements.txt.
PayoutSerializer now returns only the last four digits of account numbers.
Removed csrf_exempt from the legacy export view.
CORS restricted to the dashboard origin.
Payout checksums switched to SHA-256 with HMAC signing.
Tokens now expire after 8 hours and are rotated on password change.
DEBUG turned off on staging, and staging moved behind the VPN.
Invoice lookups are now scoped to request.user.organization through a shared queryset mixin used by every invoice view.
The audit logger now escapes control characters in user-supplied fields.
page_size capped at 500 and large report generation moved to a Celery task.
Password validators now require 12 characters and reject common passwords.
The SSO callback validates next with url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme().
Removed SHA1PasswordHasher; affected users are forced to reset their password.
